scripts.compile: bun run build && bun scripts/generate_embedded_assets.ts && bun build --compile --minify ./server.ts --outfile popurri-app --env=inline --define process.env.BUN_STANDALONE='"true"' --external vite --external @aws-sdk/client-s3
scripts.compile:win: bun run build && bun scripts/generate_embedded_assets.ts && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-windows-x64 ./server.ts --outfile popurri-app.exe --env=inline --define process.env.BUN_STANDALONE='"true"' --external vite --external @aws-sdk/client-s3
scripts.compile:mac: bun run build && bun scripts/generate_embedded_assets.ts && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 ./server.ts --outfile popurri-app-mac --env=inline --define process.env.BUN_STANDALONE='"true"' --external vite --external @aws-sdk/client-s3
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist server.js popurri-app popurri-app.exe popurri-app-mac
